 Automagic line breaks in graph annotation? Version 0.9.2
    Winston Chang <winsto...@gmail.com> Sep 06 09:19PM -0500  

    It's definitely not possible anymore to do what the theme_title()
    function does, which is to return a function that returns a text grob.
     
    In the old theme system, a theme was a list of functions that returned
    grobs. In the new theme system, a themes is a list of lists of
    properties.
     
    I haven't tried it, but I think you'd have to run splitString() on the
    original title text, and then use that returned text as the title. For
    example:
     
    title <- "Marker1 : Similar to AAA80501.1 Lycopersicon esculentum;
    unknown; Solanum lycopersicum unknown oxidase-like protein mRNA,
    complete cds; similar to hyoscyamine 6beta-hydroxylase: SwissProt
    Accession Number P24397, flavavone-3-hydroxylase: PIR Accession Number
    S36233, and ethylene forming enzyme: encoded by GenBank Accession
    number M90294 ;cl209ct403cn544 ;COMPLETE ;RESISTANCE(6), FLOWER(71),
    FRUIT(7)"
     
    newtitle <- splitString(title, unit(10, "cm"))
     
    qplot(1:10, 1:10) + ggtitle(newtitle)
     
     
     
    -Winston

 Independent control over axis lines in 0.9.2
    Sandy Muspratt <sandy.m...@optusnet.com.au> Sep 06 04:15PM -0700  

    Hi Dennis,
    Thank you so much for you reply. You code works, but only if one axis line
    is to be modified and the other is to be removed.
    But what if I want to modify both axis lines: x-axis line coloured red and
    y-axis line coloured blue. It seems I can't do that.
     
    Version 0.9.2 gives me independent control over other x and y elements. For
    instance I can independently modify the tick marks:
     
    baseplot + theme(axis.ticks.x = element_line(colour = "red", size =
    2),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(colour = "blue", size =
    2))
     
    Or I can independently modify the grid lines:
     
    baseplot + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "red",
    size = 1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "blue",
    size = 1))
     
    But it seems the same style of code will not work to independently modify
    the axis lines:
     
    baseplot + theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "red", size = 1),
    axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "blue", size =
    1))
     
    Is there a way to apply different modifications to the axis lines?
     
    Thanks
    Sandy

     

    Winston Chang <winsto...@gmail.com> Sep 06 10:15PM -0500  

    This is one area where the theme inheritance combined with the default
    theme isn't an improvement on the old system...
     
    The problem is that in the default theme_grey(), axis.line is set to
    element_blank(), and the two elements that inherit from axis.line,
    axis.line.x and axis.line.y, inherit the blank element. Perhaps it
    would be a little easier the default for axis.line was this:
    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour=NA))
     
    At any rate, this should do the trick - you just need to set axis.line
    to something that's not element_blank():
     
    qplot(1:3, 1:3) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "red", size = 1),
    axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "blue", size = 1))
     
    -Winston
